question: Should the dashboard-design workflow be a ClawHub/bundle-style skill that consumes accepted dashboard and preview APIs, or should OpenClaw core own a bundled first-party skill and dashboard screenshot API?
rationale: The requested skill is optional distribution work, but the render/screenshot capability may require a new dashboard or preview API boundary and security policy before the skill can be implemented safely.

options.title: Stage API First, Skill Outside Core
options.body: Keep this issue open while the modular dashboard and preview-widget API direction settles, then publish the workflow as an external skill unless maintainers sponsor bundling.

options.title: Sponsor As Bundled Skill
options.body: Accept product ownership for a first-party bundled dashboard-design skill and require explicit screenshot exposure, validation, and maintenance policy.

options.title: Split Screenshot API
options.body: Open or use a narrower core/plugin API issue for dashboard rendering, and leave this issue to track only skill packaging after that seam exists.

recommendation.title: Stage API First, Skill Outside Core
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the modular dashboard and preview-widget API direction settles, then publish the workflow as an external skill unless maintainers sponsor bundling.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest available routing signal across skills/ClawHub, browser screenshot history, and related product/security review decisions.
